subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should editable Control UI composer dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature via the linked implementation PR, or should it stay deferred to the broader WebChat voice direction?
rationale: This is new user-facing microphone and Gateway RPC surface, and the choice affects provider routing, credentials, temporary audio handling, and the relationship between batch dictation and realtime Talk.

options.title: Review and land Gateway-backed dictation
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers require the linked PR to resolve proof, conflict, accessibility, and security-boundary review before merge.

options.title: Fold into broader WebChat voice tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open but make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 the product owner for the remaining STT/TTS UX split.

options.title: Do not add core dictation now
options.body: Close or defer the feature if maintainers decide realtime Talk, uploads, OS dictation, or a plugin-owned path should remain the supported surface for now.

recommendation.title: Review and land Gateway-backed dictation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers require the linked PR to resolve proof, conflict, accessibility, and security-boundary review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal from the prior server-side WebChat dictation implementation and adjacent Control UI/Gateway voice work.
